item.title: 150k GPU-hours on Isambard-AI
item.description: Keith and I have been awarded 150k GPU-hours on Isambard-AI, the UK’s national AI supercomputer in Bristol, through UKRI’s AIRR AI Open Access call.

item.title: 1st place at the Energy Idea Challenge 2023
item.description: Prescelli Annan, Niklas Jutting, Tom Burns and I won first place at the Energy Idea Challenge 2023, run by the Imperial College Energy Society and sponsored by Octopus Energy, KPMG and Guidehouse. Over a weekend, teams of students from Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, UCL and other universities put together proposals to help the UK hit its net zero targets. Ours was a wastewater heat pump system, with machine learning for predictive maintenance.
